typeTierEnvelopes.status: RATIFIED — SCP-VR-6 (David, 2026-08-01). Per-type tier ranges are constrained to the envelope OBSERVED in real papers rather than a uniform T1–T5, so no generator or batch may draft an insert-letter item at T5 or a read-and-reason item at T1.
